proposals.evidence: Turner pūra explicitly records Punjabi/Lahnda pūrā full, Nepali puro complete, Oriya purā and Gujarati pūrũ full. These whole/unbroken survey responses match that adjective family, preserving local aspiration and r/ṛ/ḷ spellings. Nasal-final pūrṇ-/puron-like responses are excluded because their learned versus inherited history and possible old/whole sense confusion need separate review.

proposals.evidence: Turner sāra explicitly records Hindi/Punjabi sārā whole and Old Marwari sāro all/complete/whole. The Kaithal sārā answer matches this family. It is distinguished from sarva, despite the overlapping all/whole senses.
